body: #TSRExclusiveDetails: A police encounter in Arkansas caught on dash cam earlier this month has gone viral. The video footage posted by Arkansas Police Activity on YouTube shows a high-speed vehicle pursuit that ended with a backseat passenger being beaten by police. ____________________________________ In a clip that has since gone viral, a Trooper can be seen pulling a backseat passenger through a broken window by his locs. He is then punched and pulled from the backseat before being handcuffed. ____________________________________ The man from the video, who has since been identified as Tedrick Washington Jr., told The Shade Room, “I’m corporating, and they’re using excessive force!!”...
